d:
Anant sinh ki beti shivangi ke tilak samaroh men khas parivarik mahaul dekhne ko mila. chhote sarkar jab tilak samaroh men pahunche to hone vale samdhi ranvijay sinh ne garmajoshi ke sath unka svagat kiya. donon parivaron ke bich dikhi aatmiyta aur khas mulakat ne samaroh ki raunak barha di. dekhie tilak samaroh ki ye khas tasviren.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
